svg.title: Figure 4.7: Cap-level prunes in kernel order
svg.desc: At the stop bbef1c8e…, every pair of one of the 83 height-4 units and one of the 600 caps, coloured by the cap-level prune that removed it: blocked, target not whole, or lattice inside
svg.text: Figure 4.7: Cap-level prunes in kernel order
State bbef1c8e… · 83 height-4 units × 600 caps = 49,800 pairs. Each cell is the first cap-level prune in the kernel's order.
Caps (kernel order); rows are height-4 units in kernel order
Committed research evidence · provisional colours · no Windows/DirectX or performance claim
